This advisory contains the RPM packages for Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.17.51. See the following advisory for the container images for this release:

https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHSA-2026:4510

Security Fix(es):

* golang: net/url: Memory exhaustion in query parameter parsing in net/url (CVE-2025-61726)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

All OpenShift Container Platform 4.17 users are advised to upgrade to these updated packages and images when they are available in the appropriate release channel. To check for available updates, use the OpenShift CLI (oc) or web console.
